otp.title: Sign in with your National ID
otp.challenged_uniform: If that National ID is registered and has a phone number on file, a code has been sent. Enter it below.

session.expiring: Your session closes in a few minutes. Finish this step or sign in again.
session.expired: Your session has closed. Sign in again to continue.

identity.not_found_uniform: We could not find that record.

staff.title: Staff
staff.lead: Create officers, give them posts, and end their access. You administer your own agency only. A new officer's one-time activation code is released by a second administrator, never by you.

activation.RELEASE_AVAILABLE: Waiting for you to release the code
activation.PENDING_SECOND_ADMIN: Pending release by a second administrator
activation.RELEASED_WAITING_OFFICER: Code released; waiting for the officer to activate

staff.decisionAuthorityNotice: Decision authority can shortlist and accept candidates. The grant is audited.

create.title: Create an officer
create.badHandle: Use 3 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.

created.title: {{handle}} was created
created.body: Pending release by a second administrator. Another administrator of your agency must release the activation code; you will not see it.

done.reissue: Activation reopened for {{handle}}. A different administrator must release the code.

assign.title: Change posts for {{handle}}?
assign.body: Choose the posts and the reason. The change is recorded.
assign.consequence: {{handle}} will be signed out now and sign in again with the new posts.

disable.title: Disable {{handle}}?
disable.body: The account cannot sign in until it is enabled again.

enable.title: Enable {{handle}}?
enable.body: The account can sign in again.
enable.consequence: {{handle}} can sign in with the existing password.

revoke.title: Sign {{handle}} out everywhere?
revoke.body: Every open session of this officer ends. The account stays active.

reissue.title: Reissue the activation for {{handle}}?
reissue.body: Any code already released stops working. A different administrator must release a new one.
reissue.consequence: The creating administrator and you cannot release it.

refusals.GENERIC: The request could not be completed: {{code}}. Nothing was changed.
refusals.INVALID_HANDLE: That handle is not valid. Use 3 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
refusals.UNKNOWN_POST: One of the posts is not recognised.
refusals.AGENCY_ADMIN_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: The administrator post cannot be granted here.
refusals.INVALID_REASON: Choose one of the listed reasons.
refusals.SELF_MODIFICATION: You cannot change your own account.
refusals.NOT_FOUND: That officer is not in your agency.
refusals.LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: This is the last active administrator and cannot be disabled.
refusals.NOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION: This officer has already activated. Use disable or assign instead.
refusals.SAME_ADMIN: You created or reissued this activation, so a different administrator must release the code.
refusals.ALREADY_RELEASED: The code has already been released. Reissue it to get a new one.
refusals.ACTIVATION_EXPIRED: The release window has passed. Reissue the activation.
refusals.PERMISSION_DENIED: Your post does not permit this.

release.title: Activation code
release.body: Give this code to {{handle}} in person. They enter it on the activation screen and choose their own password.
release.onceBody: This code is not stored and cannot be shown again. If it is lost, reissue the activation.
release.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the code and copy it by hand.
release.sheetNote: Keep this sheet private. It works once. Destroy it after the officer has activated.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.lead: Enter the handle and one-time code you were given, then choose your password.
activate.done: Your account is active. You can sign in now.
activate.rejected: That handle and code were not accepted. Check them, or ask your administrator to reissue the activation.
activate.weak: Choose a password of at least {{min}} characters.
activate.failed: Activation could not be completed. Try again.
